# Sweet Protection

> > Norwegian manufacturer of premium protective sports equipment featuring Mips, 2Vi, and RIG technologies for cycling, skiing, snowboarding, and whitewater sports.

Sweet Protection specializes in advanced helmet systems and protective gear certified to CE EN 1078, CPSC 1203, and ASTM standards. The brand partners with professional teams like Uno-X and collaborates with fashion brands like Holzweiler.

## Key Topics

- Mips technology
- 2Vi helmet system
- RIG lens technology
- Falconer Aero 2Vi Mips Helmet
- Trailblazer Mips Helmet
- CE EN 1078 certification
- CPSC 1203 standard
- ASTM testing
- 3S-Technology protective gear
- Back Protector Vest 2.0
- Bike helmets (road, MTB, full-face)
- Ski and snowboard helmets
- Impact protection
- Norwegian design

## Helmets

- [Helmets | Sweet Protection](https://sweetprotection.com/us/en/helmets): Complete helmet catalog for biking, skiing, snowboarding, whitewater sports
- [Bike Helmets | Sweet Protection](https://sweetprotection.com/us/en/helmets/bike-helmets): Bike helmet catalog: road, MTB, full-face, and commuter helmets with Mips

## Protective Gear

- [Protection | Sweet Protection](https://sweetprotection.com/us/en/protection): 3S-Technology protective gear: back, knee, elbow, shin guards for sports

- [About Certificates and DOC (NO) | Sweet Protection](https://sweetprotection.com/no/no/certifications-and-decelerations-of-conformity/about-certifications): Helmet certification guide: CE EN 1078, CPSC 1203, ASTM testing standards
